task: second short-video dataset for RQ2 + MicroLens raw-content assessment
why: only candidate that is reachable this week, is short-video from a different platform than MicroLens, has image(visual)+text features, and is widely used (MMSSL, DiffMM, LightGT/MMGCN-family variants, IIMRec 2607.24607, MURAL 2609.04574)
FREEDOM is reported on this exact TikTok version by at least two papers: IIMRec arXiv 2607.24607 (R@20 0.0900, N@20 0.0398) and MURAL arXiv 2609.04574 (R@20 0.1100, N@20 0.0458)
Zhou et al.'s dataset (DY/NineRec) is NOT reachable (Drive 403), so the ideal choice is unavailable

candidates.name: DY (Douyin) from NineRec - the dataset Zhou et al. (2508.05377) used
candidates.reachable: NO: both Drive files return HTTP 403 on /view and 404 on uc download (other public Drive files tested from the same host return 200, so it is not our network); no alternative host found (recsys.westlake.edu.cn has no NineRec; HF search empty); GitHub issue #3 reports download errors
candidates.license: none in repo (GitHub license=null; issue #4 asking for license unanswered)
candidates.modalities: raw covers (300x400) + Chinese/English titles; Zhou extracted ResNet image + sentence-transformer text features
candidates.stats: 17,876 users / 5,200 items / 124,418 interactions (Zhou et al. Table 2)
candidates.freedom_reported: Zhou et al. Table 5/6: FREEDOM DY R@10 0.2162 original, w/o V 0.2119, w/o T 0.2228, interaction-only 0.2226 (single run, 8:1:1 random split)
candidates.verdict: ideal but unreachable; request from NineRec corresponding author by email

candidates.name: TikTok (MMSSL/DiffMM preprocessed)
candidates.reachable: YES: all 6 files downloaded via raw.githubusercontent.com (HTTP 200). MMSSL's own Drive folders: 1AB1Rsn... requires sign-in, 1hLvoS7... 404
candidates.license: none (DiffMM & MMSSL repos license=null); original ICME'19 ByteDance challenge site returns 502 - terms unverifiable
candidates.modalities: visual 128-d (video-frame features from challenge release, encoder undocumented, no raw images), acoustic 128-d, text 768-d Sentence-BERT of captions; no raw content
candidates.stats: 9,308 users (papers say 9,319) / 6,710 items / 68,722 interactions (train 59,541 / valid 3,051 / test 6,130); valid & test are exactly 1 item per user

candidates.name: TikTok (MMGCN original version)

candidates.reachable: YES (HEAD 200 on all files; range GET works; server 403s the Python-urllib UA)

tiktok_conversion.loader_check: RecDataset: n_users=9308 n_items=6710 n_train=59541 n_valid=3051 n_test=6130; v_feat (6710,128) t_feat (6710,768)

feature_geometry_mean_pairwise_cos.note: 200k random pairs, seed 0; Baby/MicroLens image values reproduce the paper's 0.22/0.51

smoke_test.note: GPU shared with the running patience-control campaign (~96% util, 4 procs) -> timings are upper bounds

cost_estimate_8seeds_3conds.assumptions: sec/epoch 0.94-1.38 measured under contention (incl. valid + per-epoch pre-processing); best epoch UNKNOWN (val R@20 still rising at epoch 200); per-run = (best_epoch+100 patience)*sec/epoch; best-epoch range assumed 300-1000 by analogy to converged Baby (52-493) and MicroLens (541-944)
cost_estimate_8seeds_3conds.wall_if_4_parallel: ~1-3 h (each run <0.5 GB GPU memory), subject to contention with the running campaign
cost_estimate_8seeds_3conds.unverified: no converged TikTok run yet; first converged seed will pin this down

microlens_raw.id_mapping: Recsys/data/microlens/i_id_mapping.csv (asin = raw video id); verified 705,174/705,174 inter rows match raw pairs with identical timestamps; the .tsv mappings are a different 14,079-item subset
microlens_raw.covers: all 17,228 our items present in MicroLens-100k_covers.zip (<raw_id>.jpg, 640x360 RGB); our subset 600.7 MB compressed; 8 covers range-fetched and decoded
microlens_raw.titles: all 17,228 items have an English title
microlens_raw.released_feature_encoders: IDENTIFIED: Recsys microlens image_feat/text_feat/video_feat are bit-identical (17,228/17,228 rows, max|diff|=0) to official MicroLens-100k CLIP-RN50 image / BGE-M3 title_en text / VideoMAE video features (row = raw_id-1); re-encoding 8 covers with open_clip RN50 gives cos 0.990-0.999 (others 0.49-0.67); 8 titles with bge-m3 CLS gives cos 1.0000
microlens_raw.clip_reencode_feasible_in_a_day: YES: download ~601 MB at 7.2 MB/s (~1.5 min); CPU RN50 measured ~1.0 s/image under contention (~5 h for 17,228 on CPU); a GPU pass would take minutes but was not run (campaign occupies GPU)

open_issues: TikTok does not test Zhou et al.'s DY single-run claim directly (DY unreachable); email NineRec authors
TikTok license/terms unverifiable (no repo license; challenge site down) -> do not redistribute in anonymous release
TikTok 'image' is a 128-d video-frame feature from an undocumented encoder, not a cover picture; no raw content to re-encode
TikTok valid/test are 1 item per user over 3,051/6,130 users -> Recall@20 = HR@20; binomial SE at p~0.08 is ~0.0035 (~4% relative), floors likely wider than on Baby
User count 9,308 vs 9,319 reported by papers - unexplained
TikTok image features are highly anisotropic (mean pairwise cos 0.856); FREEDOM's kNN image graph may be degenerate - check before interpreting a null
FREEDOM hyperparameters untuned for TikTok (same single config); 200-epoch test R@20 0.0765 vs 0.090/0.110 reported elsewhere (not converged)
Converged per-run cost not measured (would exceed the 10-min GPU test budget)
Paper text says MicroLens image encoder is undocumented - now identified as CLIP-RN50 (text BGE-M3); paper caveat should be updated
